warnings: Copper curves use inscribed polygons and drills use circumscribed polygons at the stated tolerance; no geometric gap snapping is performed.
geometry.z_convention: Copper midplanes; positive Z down from the top copper surface.

kero_limits: Fixed-temperature 2.5D DC conduction on saved copper; no source-droop, contact-resistance or electrochemical solve.
Cycle-average load conduction loss is not the actual time-average I-squared-R loss of switching currents.
Per-pad absolute-current envelope is a noncoincident stress case, not the observed cell peak.
GND fields use reversed currents at a shifted mathematical 3 V reference. Interpret voltage-drop magnitudes as physical ground rise.
Physical op-amp ground currents include the explicit hidden-global-ground assignment from the vendor family model. Raw model discrepancies remain in power-budget.json.
Local current-density peaks require a separate convergence result and do not establish ampacity or hardware qualification.
kero_load_basis: Cycle-average positive DC loads; ideal capacitor mean currents omitted under saved pi-mean-policy.json. GND currents reversed at a mathematical 3 V reference; physical ground rise is the solved drop magnitude.

model: 2.5D DC copper conduction; layered sheets and plated barrels

analytics.notice: Areas and volumes describe meshed copper on the selected net(s); floating copper is reported separately. Via loss is separate and is not assigned twice to its endpoint layers. Hotspots are mesh-dependent cell/barrel estimates, not whole-track ratings. Adiabatic pulse screening does not predict actual fusing or steady-state temperature.
analytics.thickness_basis: Actual triangle thickness from saved board stackup or explicit stackup override; no nominal copper-weight guess.

feasibility.notice: Feasibility covers the declared DC current budget and sink voltage windows only. An infeasible result is a requested-load diagnostic, not an attainable operating point. Current-limit foldback, load undervoltage response and return-path losses are not modeled.

bottlenecks.section_basis: mesh cell; a physical track cross-section has not been identified

fusing.heat_capacity_model: piecewise-linear NIST-JANAF Cu(cr), 250–1358 K; fixed molar mass 0.063546 kg/mol
fusing.notice: Adiabatic melting screen, not fuse opening, clearing I²t or certified ampacity. No cooling, substrate heat flow, expansion, arcing or current redistribution. The linear resistivity law is an explicit high-temperature approximation; Cp is interpolated NIST pure-copper data. Local peaks depend on mesh and contacts. A DC imposed-current pattern is held fixed during heating; long predicted times are particularly affected by omitted cooling.
fusing.ranking_basis: Local J-based regions separated in board XY per layer; not geometric neck/minimum-cut detection. Corner/contact peaks require mesh refinement.

thermal_assumptions.notice: No cooling, heat spreading, temperature feedback, melting or fuse-opening simulation. Not a fusing-current certification.

terminal_units.assumption: Pads within each explicitly selected unit are ideal equipotential contacts. The FEM distributes the total unit current by copper conductance; no equal pad-current split is assumed.
